title: syngramma elaphoglossoides
intro: Syngramma elaphoglossoides, commonly known as the Elaphoglossum fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in the Pacific Islands, for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Syngramma elaphoglossoides include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities.
